rationale: The discourse has stabilized into a clear, repeated impasse: labour/state/family hold firm on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/investors keep both as necessary fallback instruments. Rounds 2 and 3 added quantified language and side-by-side testing demands, but no side has meaningfully moved on the core contested issues, so facilitation should shift to a more forceful intervention rather than another open-ended round.
